question: GT 23 is related to FP 6 in a certain way. HP 21 is related to GL 4 in a similar way. Following a similar method, OL 15 is related to which option?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04e89cad9a0744c8938a5a00e510011212398d831d2454a448afe4ef75e32d42.png] 

Pattern followed here is,

GT 23 is related to FP 6 in a certain way. 

G - 1 = F

T - 4 = P

23 - 17 = 6

HP 21 is related to GL 4 in a similar way. 

H - 1 = G

P - 4 = L

21 - 17 = 4
